subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for the partial current-media fallback in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94139, or should maintainers close/narrow it because the latest release already covers the basic single-image native-vision path?
rationale: Current source and release evidence cover single-image forwarding, but the open linked PR uses closing syntax for a related partial-media contract that ClawSweeper should not settle without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep canonical for linked PR
options.body: Leave this issue open until the linked PR is repaired with source-aligned partial delivery and real Telegram/equivalent proof, then close through the merged fix.

options.title: Narrow or split remaining scope
options.body: If the single-image symptom is considered fixed, create or designate a narrower tracker for partial current-media fallback before closing this broader issue.

options.title: Close after rejecting partial delivery
options.body: If maintainers want to keep the all-or-nothing fallback contract, close the linked PR and then close this issue with that product decision and the current single-image release evidence.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical for linked PR
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the linked PR is repaired with source-aligned partial delivery and real Telegram/equivalent proof, then close through the merged fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent mixed image attachment ordering contract in the same resolver, making them the clearest owner for the partial-media semantics question.
